resources.string: Pray Watch is a simple, modern prayer app that leverages the latest technologies in an elegant interface.
First things first, let\'s help you personalize your settings!
With Pray Watch, you can customize your notification alerts, setup pre-Adhan reminders, and even snooze the alerts for later so you never miss a prayer!
To calculate the prayer times accurately for your city, we need your location while using the app, Precise location is not required.
Your location data stays on your device. We never collect or store it anywhere else.
Ensure that prayer notifications are scheduled during device maintenance or charging times.
Pray Watch synchronizes your settings and preferences across all devices in real-time. This is important for Google Watch use. Ensure you are logged into Google Drive and have it enabled.
Successful indeed are the believers; Who are humble in their prayers.\n[Qur\'an, 23:1–2]
Please select the calculation method that best matches your local authority or institution.

Your device does not support compass functionality.\n This means the Qibla direction cannot be determined using your device’s internal sensors. You can still use other features of the app, but to view the Qibla direction accurately, a device with a magnetic compass sensor is required.
